name: South Dakota Intrastate Pipeline
researcher_notes: The South Dakota Public Utilities Commission list of intrastate gas transmission operators names South Dakota Intrastate Pipeline Co, Pierre, federal pipeline safety operator ID 30024, and says it operates 178 miles of transmission pipeline in central South Dakota. It is an operating line with no GEM row under any name (no South Dakota rows in the roster apart from an unrelated Northern Natural Gas project). Only one source found, so medium. Endpoints, diameter, capacity and route were not found, so those are blank. The 178 miles may be a system total of several segments, so a person should check whether to split it. Intrastate lines do not appear in FERC filings. Owner is spelled as the regulator lists it; no legal-form match in the owner list. Route notes: no official map found.
